topic: Missing just the 10 best days in the stock market over 20 years can cut your total return roughly in half
title: Missing 10 Days in the Market Can Halve Your Returns
description:
Wall Street's own data shows that missing just the 10 best days in the stock market over 20 years can cut your total returns by more than half. Here's why trying to time the market is so dangerous.

#investing #stockmarket #personalfinance #indexfunds
